event_summary: A vial is positioned under a dispensing nozzle and is filled with a dark brown liquid. The vial remains stationary while the liquid level rises steadily. After filling, the vial is moved out of the dispensing area, and a second vial is brought into position to be filled.
target_vial: A clear glass vial held in a black plastic holder attached to a metal stand. It is positioned directly under a vertical dispensing nozzle.
observed_stages: The vial is empty and waiting under the nozzle.
The dark brown liquid begins dispensing into the vial.
The vial fills steadily with the dark brown liquid.
The vial is moved away from the dispensing nozzle.
A second vial is positioned under the nozzle to begin filling.
color_changes: The liquid inside the vial becomes uniformly dark brown as it fills.
